newsitem.title: USA: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.

text.p: Analysts estimate Friday's hog slaughter from 355,000 to 365,000 head versus 360,000 a week ago and 350,000 a year ago.
Saturday's hog slaughter estimates ranged from 52,000 to 150,000 head against 152,000 a week ago and 114,000 a year ago.
Cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 120,000 to 128,000 head versus 133,000 a week ago and 132,000 a year ago.
Saturday's cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 25,000 to 30,000 head versus 34,000 a week ago and 72,000 a year ago.
